name: Achish
summary: A Philistine king of Gath who took David in while he was running from Saul. He trusted David and gave him the town of Ziklag.

key_moments.title: Takes David for a Madman
key_moments.description: When David fled to Achish, the king's servants knew him as the one the women sang about, and David was afraid. He acted like a madman, and Achish asked why they had brought a madman to him.

key_moments.title: Gives David Ziklag
key_moments.description: David and six hundred men came to live with Achish, and Achish gave him Ziklag. David raided other peoples but let Achish think he was raiding Judah, and Achish believed him.

key_moments.title: Sending David Home
key_moments.description: The Philistine princes would not let David go into battle with them. Achish told David he had found no evil in him, but sent him back.
